name: Little Tree | 200mg Live Resin Gummies | Cherry
description:
10 Gummies | 20MG Each | Live Resin

Bold. Consistent. Adventure-Ready.

Our Cherry Live Resin Gummies are a terpene-rich tribute to a classic fruit profile. Each gummy delivers 20MG of true-to-plant live resin for a smooth, euphoric experience and a deep cherry flavor that lingers.

With a clean finish and consistent texture, this gummy is a reliable pick for those seeking both flavor and function.

Whether you're savoring the moment or seeking inspiration—this gummy delivers the spark.
